name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or feature enhancement for ZeroWaste
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''
---

## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you are proposing.

## 💡 Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or user pain point? (e.g. "Volunteers struggle to locate delivery destinations in remote areas without map routing").

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented:
- How should the user interface change?
- What user roles (Vendor, NGO, Volunteer, All) will benefit?
- Any API endpoint changes or socket events required?

## 🎨 Design Mockups / Wireframes
If applicable, attach UI mockups or structural diagrams.

## 🔮 Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context or references about the feature request here.
